summary: Short retest of the v3 back-cover fix. Backend: 17/17 pytest pass. meta.back_photo is 'back_photo_v3.jpg' and the asset returns 200 (880x1248). Desktop 1920x800 flip: TOC -> profil-penulis -> next reaches 'Hal. 229 / 229'. The back cover loads /api/assets/back_photo_v3.jpg. current-section-title reads 'Cover Belakang' and the tagline 'There is no easy in becoming The New No. 1' is present. A close-up of the top 70px of the rendered cover shows only dark purple: no CCTV, projector or ceiling sliver. The raw v3 jpg still has a ~35px beige ceiling band at the top-right, but the .back3::before gradient (9% height) hides it. Mobile 390x844 reading view: .rv-back-scaled is 336x476.5 and the inner cover lines up exactly (same top, scale 0.7636). scrollWidth 390 = clientWidth 390, so no horizontal overflow, and the full cover shows correctly.

issues: Cosmetic only: the raw back_photo_v3.jpg still has a beige ceiling band (~35px of 1248) at the top-right. The purple gradient hides it, so nothing shows when rendered. Cropping ~40px more would make the asset clean without needing the gradient.

critical_code_review_comments: The header label condition (Reader.jsx:204) correctly also covers the desktop spread where the back cover is the right-hand page (current+1).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Back cover: btn-toggle-toc -> toc-link-profil-penulis -> btn-next-page until disabled (229). In mobile reading mode, do NOT set scrollTop on every element: .rv-back-scaled is overflow:hidden and setting its scrollTop shifts the image and gives a false clipping result.
